cases.purpose: Verify buffered and formatted partial writes fail with EPIPE and recover in the same shell.
cases.oracle: A bounded Linux pipe is filled after a verified prefix; closing its last reader forces EPIPE with SIGPIPE ignored. The driver checks diagnostic, status and a subsequent cat and marker.
cases.comparison: Independent semantic checks on both output paths; no diagnostic-prefix parity assumption.
cases.stdout:
plain: partial output, EPIPE, status and recovery verified
number: partial output, EPIPE, status and recovery verified

files.broken-recovery.py:
import fcntl, os, subprocess, sys
shell = sys.argv[1]
with open("payload", "wb") as f:
    f.write(b"x" * (1024 * 1024))
for mode in ("plain", "number"):
    r, w = os.pipe()
    try:
        fcntl.fcntl(w, fcntl.F_SETPIPE_SZ, 4096)
        if fcntl.fcntl(w, fcntl.F_GETPIPE_SZ) >= 1024 * 1024:
            raise RuntimeError("pipe capacity does not force a blocked writer")
        script = r'''[[ $(type -t cat) == builtin ]] || exit 90
trap "" PIPE
if [[ $1 == number ]]; then cat -n payload; else cat payload; fi
rc=$?
exec > recovery
printf 'status=%s\n' "$rc"
cat <<<'ok'
printf 'marker\n'
'''
        p = subprocess.Popen([shell, "--noprofile", "--norc", "-c", script, "fixture", mode], stdout=w, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    finally:
        os.close(w)
    try:
        data = b""
        while len(data) < 4096:
            part = os.read(r, 4096 - len(data))
            if not part:
                break
            data += part
    finally:
        os.close(r)
    try:
        _, err = p.communicate(timeout=10)
    except BaseException:
        p.kill()
        p.wait()
        raise
    prefix = (b"     1\t" if mode == "number" else b"")
    assert data == (prefix + b"x" * 4096)[:4096], (mode, len(data), data[:20])
    assert p.returncode == 0, (mode, p.returncode, err)
    assert b"write" in err and b"Broken pipe" in err, (mode, err)
    with open("recovery", "rb") as f:
        assert f.read() == b"status=1\nok\nmarker\n", mode
    print(mode + ": partial output, EPIPE, status and recovery verified")
